2607.10366.title: Co4ICF: Co-evolving Physics-Informed Surrogate and RL-based Pulse Optimizer for Inertial Confinement Fusion
2607.10366.paper_summary: Offline-trained surrogates for Inertial Confinement Fusion (ICF) suffer a well-known failure mode that iterative optimizers drive inputs into out-of-distribution (OOD) regions where predictions become unreliable. Here we present Co4ICF, a co-evolving framework that couples a physics-informed surrogate with a PPO-based pulse optimizer. The surrogate is iteratively fine-tuned on policy-induced trajectories, correcting extrapolation errors as the optimizer shifts the input distribution; the optimizer queries this evolving surrogate as a fast environment. In the 1D MULTI environment, Co4ICF achieves 146.1% normalized yield based on current laser design baseline; as a post-hoc cross-fidelity check, the optimized pulse further attains 246.9% normalized yield when directly evaluated in 2D-MULTI without any 2D training or fine-tuning. Budget-matched ablations support that the gains are not explained solely by additional simulation data and are consistent with the co-evolving mechanism playing a key role. We release a large-scale MULTI-IFE simulation dataset to support future benchmarking.
2607.10366.paper_summary_zh: 離線訓練的替代模型在慣性約束融合（ICF）中遭遇一種眾所周知的失效模式，即迭代優化器將輸入推入分佈外（OOD）區域，導致預測變得不可靠。在此，我們提出了Co4ICF，一個將物理知識替代模型與基於PPO的脈衝優化器結合的共同演化框架。替代模型在策略誘導的軌跡上進行迭代微調，隨著優化器改變輸入分佈，修正外推誤差；優化器將這個不斷演變的替代模型作為快速環境進行查詢。在1D MULTI環境中，Co4ICF基於當前激光設計基線實現了146.1%的標準化產量；作為事後的交叉保真度檢查，當在2D-MULTI中直接評估時，優化後的脈衝進一步達到246.9%的標準化產量，且無需任何2D訓練或微調。與預算匹配的消融實驗支持這些增益並非僅由額外的模擬數據解釋，並且與共同演化機制在其中發揮關鍵作用的觀點一致。我們釋放了一個大規模的MULTI-IFE模擬數據集，以支持未來的基準測試。
